notes: Expectations-only: these flows need a tenant with Universal Portals enabled, so review the transcript by hand. Each case checks the confirmation gate before any write.

evals.prompt: Create a consumer self-service portal on my tenant dev-example.us.auth0.com. Call it Acme Account.
evals.expected_output: Confirms tenant, template, name and slug with the user, then runs auth0-beta universal-portals setup with --template consumer --no-input --json, and reports portal URL and statuses from the JSON result.
expectations: Routes to the Universal Portals reference
Asks the user to confirm tenant, template, name and slug before running setup
Runs auth0-beta universal-portals setup --template consumer --name "Acme Account" with --no-input and --json
Does not use --template business or ask for a user and organization
Reports the portal URL from the JSON result and never prints a client secret
On a missing_scopes error, follows the fix list from the error instead of guessing scopes
Does not claim the portal is on a non-production-only feature

evals.prompt: Set up a business portal for my organization admins on dev-example.us.auth0.com. The test admin is jane@acme.com.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the plan, runs setup with --template business --user jane@acme.com --no-input --json, checks organization.hasRole in the result and explains what is missing if false.
expectations: Asks for or confirms name and slug before running setup
Passes --organization when the user belongs to several organizations
Reads organization.hasRole from the JSON result and warns that organization components will not work when it is false
Builds the portal link with the organization parameter
Does not create an organization or role itself

evals.prompt: Audit my portal up_abc123 on dev-example.us.auth0.com and fix whatever is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit without --fix first, shows findings, asks for approval, runs audit --fix, then re-runs audit and reports what remains.
expectations: Runs auth0-beta universal-portals audit up_abc123 --json first, without --fix
Summarises findings by severity and names those that are manual-only
Warns that --fix can create a portal application and delete Management API grants
Asks for approval before running audit --fix
Re-runs audit after the fix and reports remaining errors
Does not hand-edit the portal application when --fix can repair it
